exposure: Intrathecal injection of ephedrine combined with bupivacaine
outcome: Incidence of hypotension, hypertension, tachycardia, nausea, and vomiting
Maternal peripheral venous blood noradrenaline levels
cohort: 107 patients undergoing elective cesarean section under combined spinal epidural anesthesia.
finding: Intrathecal injection of ephedrine combined with bupivacaine effectively maintained maternal hemodynamics and prolonged the time of sensory spinal block compared to bupivacaine alone.
